## `neuro.string.localeCompare`

Instance method on `String.prototype`.

> Determines whether two strings are equivalent in the current locale.
>
> Determines whether two strings are equivalent in the current or specified locale.

## Signatures

```ts
localeCompare(input: { string: <receiver>; that: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
localeCompare(input: { string: <receiver>; that: string; locales?: string | string[]; options?: Intl.CollatorOptions; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
localeCompare(input: { string: <receiver>; that: string; locales?: Intl.LocalesArgument; options?: Intl.CollatorOptions; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.prototype.localeCompare` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
